ads-red.why: X keeps the vivid red/orange columns, peach lower-centre glow and the distinct grey-blue column; Y is muddier and flatter.

agents-pale.why: Y has the reference's striated hairline texture and broader, more purple-navy mass; X is a smooth saturated blue blob.

api-grey.why: X reproduces the fine fanning streak texture and dark lower-right band; Y's smooth S-curve sweep and hard dark corner don't match.

architect-square.why: X's straighter diagonal boundary and blue-lavender left edge read closer; Y curves too much, though its cyan fringe is a nice touch.

architect-wide.why: X places the maroon-then-navy wedge and the lighter top-right corner where the reference has them; Y pushes saturated blue to the edge.

atom-band.why: Y matches the pale-top boundary height and the thin pink-fringed light streak on the left; X has an oversized blue wedge.

belgium-amber.why: Y carries blue down the right side like the reference and lacks X's stray dark hairline in the amber.

cobalt-openai.why: X has the fine streak texture and darker mid-right streak bands; Y is too soft and smooth.

coral-green.why: Y concentrates the dark green mass lower-left with coral bottom-right and a bright centre streak; X spreads green streaks across the whole bottom.

coral-pink.why: Y's blue-grey top-left corner with the orange edge matches better; X's corner turns greenish.

defining-navy.why: X gets the light lower-right region size and maroon bottom-left corner; Y's dark spreads across the top and shrinks the light area.

detect-navy.why: Y's clearer cyan hairline and lighter blue bands in the dark region echo the reference's streak structure.

elections-green.why: Y keeps green streaks running through the pale lower area like the reference; X's bottom goes flat.

fedramp-oxblood.why: X's mid blue-grey top-left and streaky dark area are closer, though its rainbow fringe is overdone; Y's top-left is too dark.

green-peach-blur.why: X's peach blob size and position and its rounded top-right peach patch match; Y's blob is too big and its top-right patch is a narrow strip.

lavender-cream.why: X's larger black top-right and cream-to-lavender boundary height match better, though Y has the lavender left edge.

letter-sky.why: Y has the rising diagonal streaks and the mid-left pink streak; X's streaks are horizontal.

mcp-coral.why: X has the radial streaky coral burst with pale edges; Y is a smooth blob with a red mass in the wrong place.

netherlands-amber.why: Y's fine streaks and beige-cream highlights match; X's highlights are saturated pale-orange blobs.

pink-lilac.why: X's streaky darker top-left band, thin magenta lower-right streak and lilac corner match; Y's top band is a flat solid wedge.

reader-pastel.why: Y's many small scattered teal blobs and all-over streak texture match the busy reference; X's few large soft blobs read too simple.

reception-green.why: Y has the dark green left spot and more blue through the middle; X's green covers too much of the left half.

red-burst.why: Y's chunky broken petals and pale left edge match the reference; X is long smooth fan streaks.

rust-blur.why: Y's smaller rust spot, dark right-edge accent and cream bottom-left match the reference layout; X's rust blob is far too big.

scribe-green.why: Y has finer, straighter streak texture; X's streaks arc too much.

sdr-amber.why: X's soft blue left region and orange top-right are closer; Y's blue has a hard diagonal edge and is too big.

sdr-oxblood.why: Y's larger dark top-left mass and bottom-right oxblood match better; X's top-left is a thin band.

sfx-grey.why: Y's top dark streak rises diagonally like the reference; X's is flat, though X's mid mass reaches further left.

silk-blue.why: X's straighter pale band and pure blue palette match better; Y bends into an S and turns teal.

sky-burst.why: X's soft blue streak running down-right from the pinch point and the blue top-right accent match; Y's tail is a hard horizontal spike.

social-cream.why: Y's broad cream upper-left over orange lower-right reads like the reference; X squeezes the cream into a narrow band.

social-ember.why: X has the red petal tongues at the bottom and the warm glow; Y turns everything into long vertical streaks.

support-teal.why: Y's mass starts and steps where the reference's does and has the warm cream at the left.

v4-turbo.why: X's short dark-red streak and redder bottom and right edges match better; Y's red streak runs too long.

workshop-red.why: X keeps the crimson left-mid band and right-centre glow; Y adds a pale pink band under the mauve.
